nodes.name: Fetch Engagements
nodes.notes: Aegis lane — Notion Audit OS. Credential name is a placeholder; wire to the existing Aegis Notion credential in n8n. Do not use Marty Party credentials.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO tt.client (name, notion_page_id)
VALUES ('{{ $json.client_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', NULL)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO tt.client (name)
SELECT '{{ $json.client_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM tt.client WHERE name = '{{ $json.client_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
);

INSERT INTO tt.stream (
  kind, client_id, name, code, notion_page_id, fiscal_year,
  fee_amount, fee_currency, billing_model, billable_default, status, sort_hint
)
SELECT
  'client',
  c.id,
  '{{ $json.name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.code.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.notion_page_id }}',
  {{ $json.fiscal_year }},
  {{ $json.fee_amount === null || $json.fee_amount === undefined ? 'NULL' : $json.fee_amount }},
  'EUR',
  'fixed',
  true,
  'active',
  now()
FROM tt.client c
WHERE c.name = '{{ $json.client_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
ON CONFLICT (notion_page_id) DO UPDATE SET
  name = EXCLUDED.name,
  fee_amount = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fee_amount, tt.stream.fee_amount),
  fiscal_year = EXCLUDED.fiscal_year,
  status = 'active';

-- Also upsert on code when notion_page_id was null historically
UPDATE tt.stream s SET
  notion_page_id = COALESCE(s.notion_page_id, '{{ $json.notion_page_id }}'),
  fee_amount = COALESCE({{ $json.fee_amount === null || $json.fee_amount === undefined ? 'NULL' : $json.fee_amount }}, s.fee_amount)
WHERE s.code = '{{ $json.code.replace(/'/g, "''") }}';
